source_note: 对含参数方程根的估计
english_source_note: Estimates for Roots of Parameterized Equations
callout_id: 对含参数方程根的估计#7
statement_en:
Let the \(N(s)\) positive roots of \(\cos(x)=sx\) be ordered as
\\[
x_1<x_2<\\cdots<x_{N(s)}.
\\]
Prove that
\\[
\\lim_{s\	o 0^{+}}s^2\\sum_{k=1}^{N(s)}\\frac{1}{(x_k-(k-1/2)\\pi)^2}=\\frac{1}{2}.
\\]
callout_body: 设$\cos(x)=sx$的$N(s)$个正根按照顺序排列为$$x_1<x_2<\cdots<x_{N(s)}$$证明$$\lim_{s\to 0^{+}}s^2\sum_{k=1}^{N(s)}\frac{1}{(x_k-(k-1/2)\pi)^2}=\frac{1}{2}$$
